items.title: Atara launches furnished boutique building on Dubai Islands
items.summary: Atara Development has launched Velora Residence on Island A, a 58-home building of fully furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments sized roughly 857 to 1,857 sq ft.

items.title: Zimaya unveils Dh185m Lawncrest in Dubai Production City
items.summary: Zimaya's fifth project is a ten-storey building with 183 studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, with studios priced from AED 595,000.

items.title: National Properties completes 399 Hills Park and starts handover
items.summary: The two-tower, 399-unit development is complete; the tower offered for sale is fully sold and owners are receiving keys, while the second tower is being held as a rental asset.
